thread:
maria.chen: Heads up — hitting a parity issue between REST and SDK: REST GET /models/:id/config returns `prefill_cache` but the Python SDK's getModelConfig() omits it, which makes the sample app mis-route caching behavior.
charlie: repro steps?
samir: any quick example output we can use to reproduce locally?
maria.chen: Repro:
```
# REST
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/rdl-1/config | jq
# => { "id": "rdl-1", "max_tokens": 2048, "prefill_cache": false, ... }

# Python SDK
from redwood import ModelsClient
mc = ModelsClient()
mc.get_model_config("rdl-1")
# => { "id": "rdl-1", "maxTokens": 2048, ... }   # no prefill_cache/prefillCache key
```
samir: that's annoying — our code in sampleapp checks for `config.get('prefillCache', True)` so missing key defaults to True and we end up enabling caching unexpectedly.
charlie: where in the SDK is the mapping happening? camelCase/snake_case conversion?
maria.chen: In python sdk: models_client._parse_config() we normalize keys to camelCase. I think the parser also filters out null/undefined-ish values. Suspect false is getting dropped by an overzealous filter.
samir: quick grep showed `parsed = {k: v for k,v in resp.items() if v}` — that will drop False and 0. :-/
charlie: oof. That explains it. Node SDK has `Object.entries(resp).reduce((acc,[k,v]) => { if (v) acc[camel(k)] = v; return acc }, {})` — same pattern.
ci-bot: CI failure reported: sampleapp/integration/test_cache.py::test_cache_disabled_on_prefill_false — 1 failed, logs attached.
maria.chen: Proposed fix: stop dropping falsy booleans and preserve explicit false. Make mapping explicit for known config fields like `prefill_cache`. Also add a test for `prefill_cache: false` and `prefill_cache: 0` (if backend historically sent numbers).
samir: I'll open a PR to change the filter to `if v is not None` in python and `if (v !== null && v !== undefined)` in node, and add tests + changelog.
charlie: ping me on the PR for a quick review. We should also add a sampleapp test that uses a mocked REST config and asserts sdk returns the same keys.
maria.chen: Also a doc note: surface the canonical field names in the API docs so SDKs can map deterministically. Right now docs show `prefill_cache` in REST but SDK docs list `prefillCache` in examples; that's confusing.
samir: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987 — includes tests, fix, and a small migration note in CHANGELOG.
charlie: will run local integration after CI passes. Thanks for catching this, @maria.chen :thumbsup: (label: devex, severity: medium)
ci-bot: CI passed for sdk/pull/987 on linux-py38, queued merge.
maria.chen: After merge, I'll update the sampleapp quickstart snippet and add a short note in onboarding checklist: "verify model config parity across SDK and REST (prefill_cache)".
samir: merging shortly, will backport to maintenance branch if needed.
charlie: great. Follow-up item: run a scan for other boolean flags being filtered the same way (e.g., `allow_unstable`, `enable_kv_cache`). Could be more parity gaps.
maria.chen: added a GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/152 — boolean-filtering-parity-scan
charlie: perfect — thanks everyone.
